name: scan_h2_bond
description: run one self-consistent pw.x calculation of one H2 molecule at each bond length named, in a cubic box at the gamma point with the Martyna-Tuckerman correction, each in its own folder of a new scan folder under runs/scan, and return the energy curve: each pair a bond length as given and the total energy pw.x printed for it, with the conditions pw.x printed, which must be the same for every point; a point that did not converge or did not end with JOB DONE ends the scan with an error

bond_lengths.description: the bond lengths to compute, each once

box_side.description: the side of the cubic box, the first of the celldm constants

ecutwfc.description: the kinetic energy cutoff for wavefunctions

ecutrho.description: the kinetic energy cutoff for charge density and potential

conv_thr.description: the convergence threshold of the self-consistent loop

n_processes.description: how many MPI processes each pw.x runs on, a positive count, through the environment's mpirun; null starts pw.x directly, without mpirun

budget_s.description: the running time each pw.x may take before the call gives up on it, counted while it runs and not while it is paused; no limit when null

pseudo_dir.description: the folder that holds the pseudopotential

run_dir.description: the scan folder, relative to this directory

energy_curve.description: pairs of a bond length in bohr, as given, and the total energy pw.x printed for it, in Ry

printed_conditions.description: what pw.x printed of the conditions, the same for every point: the cutoffs, the lattice parameter, the threshold, the processes, the exchange-correlation functional, the pseudopotential file, the species mass it used and the isolated-system correction

points.description: each point's bond length, folder, total energy, iterations and convergence as pw.x printed them

safety_gate.place: src/gate.py, consulted by src/run_tool.py before the call
